title: Delhi High Court Higher Judicial Service HJS Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 27 vacancies - 24 existing and 3 anticipated. Category-wise: General 17, SC 5, ST 5
qualification: Candidate must be a citizen of India. An Advocate must have continuously practised for at least 7 years as on 15 July 2026. Judicial Officers and persons who have been or are in judicial service must meet the prescribed 7-year combined experience requirement.
applicationFee: ₹2,000 for General category candidates and ₹500 for SC/ST/PwD candidates
documentsRequired: Admit card, valid photo ID and documents/certificates required for eligibility and subsequent verification
howToApply: The application process has closed. Candidates who applied should visit the official Delhi High Court website for HJS examination notices, results and Mains examination updates.
shortDescription: Delhi High Court HJS Examination 2026 is being conducted in three stages. The Preliminary Examination was held on 26 July 2026, while the Mains Written Examination has been rescheduled to 10 and 11 October 2026.
content:
High Court of Delhi is conducting the Delhi Higher Judicial Service Examination 2026 for 27 vacancies.

The Preliminary Examination was held on 26 July 2026. Candidates shortlisted for the Mains Written Examination should note that the Mains examination originally scheduled for 12 and 13 September 2026 has been postponed to 10 and 11 October 2026.

Candidates should check the official Delhi High Court website for the latest admit card and examination instructions.

importantDates.admitCardDate: Mains admit card - to be announced
